**Finding submitted: WARRANTY — deviation (redline validated, `ok:true`).**

What I found across the document:
- **§ 9 TrueLink Warranties (p0059–p0060)** — the only TrueLink warranty, and it is confined to Year 2000 date processing (with a Y2K-specific repair/upgrade obligation).
- **§ 11 Standard of Care (p0069)** — a bare "same degree of care, skill and prudence customarily exercised by it for its own operations" obligation; no conformance standard, no duration, no remedy.
- **§ 3 Hosting Services (p0030–p0042)** — service commitments qualified by "reasonable commercial efforts," plus an express no-warranty for data accuracy (p0042).
- **Disclaimer (p0076)** — opens "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does **not** swallow express warranties; no carve-out edit needed (and not walk-away "AS IS").
- Malicious-code and compliance-with-laws warranties run only *from Client* (p0051, p0056) — i.e., against us.

Because the fallback fails on all four elements (no 90-day software conformance, no 30-day services warranty, no repair/replace, no refund), I inserted one short warranty paragraph after p0060 at the **preferred** level, mapping all eight preferred elements to that single operation, and offered the 90/30-day fallback in the comment rather than in the operative text.
